structure.reasoning: This is a Coda welcome email with a clear onboarding structure. I identified sections by visual breaks (color changes from #EDFAFF to #D6F3FF to #FDDCB0), content boundaries, and functional purposes. The email has a unique structure with feature-explanation sections that combine images and text to explain Coda's functionality. These aren't standard articles but rather product-feature explanations, which I'm treating as a novel 'feature-explanation' type.

content.title: Welcome to Coda!

extractedData.subtitle: We're so glad you're here.
extractedData.welcomeMessage:
Hi Smiles Davis,

You're in Coda! Now what? In a world where technology and tools are ever-evolving, docs have stayed the same with their generic interfaces and bland pages. Enter Coda. Here, your productivity possibilities are exponential. For now, let's start with the basics. Let's dive in!

extractedData.title: So, what is Coda?
extractedData.description: Coda is an all-in-one workspace that brings tools and teams together in one place for better collaboration, organization, project management, and productivity.

extractedData.title: Coda is a doc with pages.
extractedData.description: Docs are where your text and data live in one place. And within each Coda doc are pages, which you can find on the lefthand panel.

extractedData.title: Transform your workflow with Coda.
extractedData.description:
Coda docs have endless features to centralize information and build collaboration.

Docs grow and evolve—taking in new information and data from your trusted sources.

extractedData.title: I'm actually more of a visual learner...
extractedData.description:
We're big on collaboration here at Coda—both in and out of the doc. That's why we've curated interactive trainings to help you learn more about Coda and how to utilize its potential from the get-go.

Sign up to join the next session here, or browse our list of webinars to discover more great learning content.

extractedData.ctaText:
Get back into Coda. The best way to get to know Coda is simply...get into Coda! If you were invited to a Coda doc...find your place again by visiting your workspace.

For more ideas, inspiration, and blueprints to help you get started, check out our Gallery. Until then, see you in Coda!
